svg.title: Chatbot evaluation and improvement loop
svg.desc: A frozen gold set, multi-turn conversations and retrieval metrics are run on each local model, recording every tool call and result. The harness flags invented citations and unverified figures; each flag is read by hand against the tool data. The cause found was that every invented citation came from an answer that never searched. Fixes went into code, were replayed on the recorded answers, then run live. The LLM judge was checked against the known inventions and failed; asked to list unsupported quotes, sources and figures instead, the same model caught all of them. Later rounds: answers are verified before they are shown; a person rated the answers and found misdescribed figures no check could flag, which were fixed in the tools and retested; and the evidence search was retested against a random draw and changed.

span.p:
Gold set v2 (32 questions) · 4 conversations
retrieval Hit@K and MRR against human aspects
chatbot.run_eval · chatbot.retrieval_eval

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Run each local model; record every
tool call and its result

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Harness flags: citations no search returned,
figures no tool returned

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Every flag read against the tool data:
25 of 26 real inventions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cause: every invention came from an answer
that never searched; the prompt rule was ignored

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fixed in code: strip evidence written without a search
(a setting) · the scope check reads the conversation
(an intent classifier since 4 Oct) · run a tool call written as text

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Replay the fix on the recorded answers:
citation warnings 11 to 0 (8B), 15 to 0 (3B)
chatbot.replay

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Run live again: 0 of 32 on the 8B;
conversations 9 of 9 on both models

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retrieval: a question as the query ranks at chance
(MRR 0.217); the aspect's name 0.559 (a setting)

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Checked against the known inventions:
scored all 32 answers 3, so not usable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Asked to list every unsupported quote,
source and figure (checklist prompt):
catches all 25 known inventions, but its
reasons are unreliable: it screens, not scores

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verify before reply: a failing draft is written again,
then trimmed; 0 of 32 answers shown carry
a figure no tool returned, on both models

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A person rated 32 answers of llama3.1:8b: 7 of the 26
the model wrote state something the tool data
contradicts, and no check flagged them

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fixed in the tools: the data's end date, a bank's rank
and its strongest and weakest topics
given as sentences for the model to copy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The 7 questions asked three times each:
gpt-6-luna right in 21 of 21 tries,
llama3.1:8b in 16 of 21

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Search retested against a random draw (precision at 5):
FinBERT ranks below it within a topic, so the question's words,
then the newest, 0.82; without a topic all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 0.31 against 0.12
